item.tib: 'od dkar dpag med tshe yi sgrub pa ye shes gra gur
item.coloph: de nas ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus la bab tshe gter srung gis dngos med rmi lam la brten nas zab pa'i bon skal du sprad pas/ dngos med gzugs su bstan nas 'ja' tshon gur ris gsum phub nas bstan sogs ni/ der yod pa'i mi yis mngon sum du mthong ba sogs byung yang btang snyoms su bzhag nas yod skabs/ rang gcig bur shar grol smin bdag gis bltas pas snga nas ma mthong gling la rig pa rkyang ded byas nas yod skabs/ gar byung med pa'i gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig gis sgo phyes nas slebs pa de yis yi ge 'di la ltad mo ltos gsungs nas pod chung zhig bdag la bstan byung / ba'i tshe sgrub g.yung drung gra gur dang / g.yang sgrub dmu yad bdud rtsi'i zil thig gnyis 'dug pa de la ltad mo res 'ga' la bltas nas phar la sprad pas/ de phar bzhag nas mi yi sgo phar thon ma tsam rlung 'tshubs su brdzus nas gar song cha med du gshegs song / de nas bdag gis sngar gyi yig ge gar yod bltas pas ma rnyed/ nang gi yig don yid la sems par byung / de nub nyal ba'i tho rangs nas lung gi bdag nyid 7stang chen dmu tsha gyer med nyid kyis tshe yi sgrub thabs dang / g.yang gi sgrab pa gnyis 'go nas 'jug gi bar du lung bstan nas/ 'di nyid dus la bab pas gter kha cha gnyis sbas pa'i dgongs don chig dril yin gsungs te/ gsal cha de 'gag song ngo / de yi phyi nyin skye ba gong nas 'grogs pa'i grogs po rigs ldan gyi snying bu dge rgan shes rab phun tshogs la smras pas/ rigs ldan de nyid kyang skye ba gong nas lha skal phog cing sgrab pa'i las 'phro sad nas/ dgyes pa'i gad mo dang dga' ba'i mchong 'khrab dang bcas te gyen ldog mi nus pa'i tshig dang*/ rten 'brel mtshon byed tshe rdzas rin chen dang po mar zhi bcas kyis sna drangs nas bskul ba dang / ma zad 7bla chung tshul khrims bstan 'dzin gyis dad 'dun mos pa chen pos yang nas yang du bskur ba dang / rang slob dpal sdis dang dkon mchog a shag bstan mchog sogs dad sbyin res 'gas bskyal ba la brten nas/ stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyi bka' yi pho nya/ sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i rjes 'breng*/ gsang 'dus mngon byon 'gro mgon tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi snying bu tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am/ gsang ba'i ming ni g.yung drung thogs med rtsal lam/ ma mchog srid pa'i rgyal mos ma gcig bu gdung gi tshul du ming ni/ d+hu na tsI ta hri ho zhes pa des/ shar grol smin gling du dkar chags (chag)yi ger btab pa'o/ dge des sags rgyas g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas shing 'dzam gling yongs la khyab pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
